text: AMCO is AMCO Intermediários de Crédito, Lda, a Portuguese credit intermediary supervised by Banco de Portugal (register no. 759). The company's own legal notice names the entity; it does not state who owns or controls it.
short: AMCO is AMCO Intermediários de Crédito, Lda, a Banco de Portugal-supervised credit intermediary.
